items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: This is Babe Regis. ... I don't forget this fellow.

ctx.x: I wouldn't be able to tell you. That's him. That's the boy. Is that you here? No, no. Oh, here. Yeah. Wait a minute. Oh, no. No, no. That's this fellow. Babe Regis. This is Babe Regis.
